3. The criminal misc. bail application no. 35606 of 2022 has been filed on behalf of the applicant Amit in case crime No. 134 of 2022, under Section 302, 201 IPC, police station Awagarh, District Etah and the criminal misc. bail application no. 18005 of 2023 has also been filed on behalf of the same applicant in the same crime number under Section 376 IPC registered at the same police station of Etah district, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in the above-referred case.

sentences.text:
Both the above-referred bail applications have been filed by applicant Amit in the same case, thus,
both the applications are being decided by this common order.
5. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

The informant has lodged the first information report on 16.06.2022 at 23:30 hours, alleging that he received information that some unknown persons have committed murder of his daughter and her dead body was thrown in the ranch.
Learned counsel submitted that applicant is not named in the first information report.

In the first information report,
the informant has inter-alia also stated the manner of committing murder of deceased and thus, it appears that the first information report was lodged after postmortem of the deceased.

On 17.06.2022 the informant has submitted an application to the police that applicant was having love affair with the deceased and he has called the deceased from Agra to return her amount of Rs.
80,000/-.
It was submitted that there is no eye witness of alleged incident.

Alleged recovery of purse, shoe and mobile phone of deceased was shown later on from the spot, where dead body of deceased was found but at the time of recovery of dead body of deceased no such article was seized from the said spot.

Referring to the statement of informant/PW-1, it was submitted that in fact the said articles were found at the place of incident at the time of recovery of dead body and thus,
alleged recovery of those articles shown at the instance of applicant is wholly doubtful and false.
Except the statement of informant, there is no other witness of fact.
Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 18.06.2022 and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.

6. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and argued that applicant was having love affair with the deceased and he has called the deceased from Agra by making telephonic call, to return her amount of Rs. 80,000/-.
Recovery of purse, shoe and mobile phone of deceased has been shown at the instance of applicant.
The weapon of offence was also recovered at the instance of applicant.
It was submitted that there is circumstantial evidence that applicant has committed murder of deceased.

7. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of the offence and all attending facts and circumstances of the matter, no case for grant of bail is made out.
8. Accordingly, the above-referred both the bail applications filed on behalf of applicant Amit are rejected.
